bio: A charming and lively trattoria that, along with La Cucina Colaianni, forms the exciting Freilager dual concept in the Albisrieden neighbourhood. With Marco Però and his team providing warm and attentive service, Antonio Colaianni whips up flavoursome Italian classics in the kitchen – from vitello tonnato and paccheri con gamberoni to filetto di branzino and the Tiramisu Freilager, which is prepared at your table. The good range of pizzas is also worth mentioning. At lunchtime, the options are more limited but include the wallet-friendly three-course Menu D'Affari, as well as daily specials and items from the evening menu. In fine weather, you can eaton the terrace. Tip for motorists: the adjacent multi-storey car park (entrance at Flurstrasse 116)....
